text.div:
Predicted waterborne biohazard arrival at Parque Dr. Manuel Braga, propagated downstream from Ponte de Santa Clara (0.24 km along the declared flow order).

Preliminary model output. Modeled chance the front has already arrived: 1%. Not a diagnosis; velocity and dispersion are illustrative, not calibrated.

outcome.text: Predicted waterborne biohazard arrival at Parque Dr. Manuel Braga, propagated downstream from Ponte de Santa Clara (0.24 km along the declared flow order).

prediction.rationale: 1D advection-dispersion (Taylor-dispersion / Fischer et al. approximation) transport model: peak arrival ~11.2 min, arrival window 3.3-19.0 min, over 0.24 km at an assumed 0.36 m/s mean velocity and 8 m^2/s dispersion coefficient -- both illustrative, NOT calibrated to a real gauge reading. Indicative WFD ecological status if this arrives unmitigated: Bad (EQR 0.1, Illustrative proxy mapping onto the real WFD 5-class EQR system -- NOT an official, type-specific, intercalibrated national assessment.). Read probabilityDecimal together with whenPeriod: it is the modeled chance the front has already arrived at the time of this assessment (near 0 at first, rising through the window), not the chance it arrives at all.
